result.query:
SELECT TOP 20000 [GroupTypeName] AS [GroupTypeName], [GroupName] AS [GroupName], [Gender] AS [Gender], [Age] AS [Age], [Measurementperiodtype] AS [Measurementperiodtype], [MeasurementPeriod] AS [MeasurementPeriod], [MeasurementPeriodDate] AS [MeasurementPeriodDate] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  MBusinessKey
    ,Version
	  ,GroupKey
	  ,MTypeBusinessKey
    ,MTypeName
	  ,MName
    ,GroupTypeName
    ,Indelning_typ_desc
	  ,Enhet
	  ,Kommun
	  ,Region
    ,GroupName
    ,MeasurementPeriod
	  ,Measurementperiodtype
	  ,MeasurementPeriodDate
	  ,PeriodStartYear
	  ,PeriodStartQuarter
	  ,IsLastPeriod
	  ,LastPeriodFilterFlag
    ,Age
    ,Gender
	  ,concat(GroupName, '; ', Age, '; ', Gender) as LegendBase
  	,ValueD0
	  ,ValueD1
	  ,Value
    ,ValueD3
    ,ValueD4
    ,ValueChar
    ,Numerator
	  ,Denominator
	  ,CIhigh
	  ,CIlow
	  ,Crude
	  ,CrudeCILow
	  ,CrudeCIHigh
    ,Commentary
    ,DataGenerationDate
    ,case when age in ('18 år eller äldre', '17 år eller yngre') then [Value] else Crude end as Value_Crude
	FROM [semantic].[VAI_OB_Trends]
) AS virtual_table 
WHERE [MBusinessKey] IN (N'OB11') AND [GroupTypeName] IN (N'Riket', N'Region') GROUP BY [GroupTypeName], [GroupName], [Gender], [Age], [Measurementperiodtype], [MeasurementPeriod], [MeasurementPeriodDate];
